_note: Demo run definitions for the live/rehearsal walkthrough. The developer's CLI (agent/run.py) reads these to script invocations; it never hardcodes a goal, budget, or narration string.

scenarios.label: Happy path — three honest merchants
scenarios.narration: Agent compares three honest merchants, picks CheapDealsStore's 45W charger at 5.75 XSGD, policy engine shows seven green checks, settles on Fuji.

scenarios.label: Above the human-approval threshold
scenarios.narration: Two TechStore 45W chargers at 7.20 XSGD each total 14.40 XSGD, above the 12.00 human-approval threshold. The agent blocks and waits for a human decision; approval does not raise the mandate.

scenarios.label: Hostile merchant, prompt injection in product copy
scenarios.narration: BargainBin hides an override instruction inside a product description (steering the agent toward its BB-G01 gift card). The pre-hook discards it as untyped text before the execution agent ever sees it — unless DEMO_INJECTION_PASSTHROUGH is explicitly set for a live before/after demo. Even if the agent proposed BargainBin, merchant_allowed fails and nothing is signed.

scenarios.label: Multi-item basket, single merchant checkout
scenarios.narration: Two line items, one merchant, one checkout. The agent prices the same charger+cable bundle at TechStore, GadgetHub and CheapDealsStore; CheapDealsStore wins at 9.75 XSGD, the cheapest merchant that can deliver every line same-day. Policy checks every line item's category, stock, delivery and price against product/catalog.json before minting a single SpendIntent for the combined total.
